sponsor: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group (Sino Biopharmaceutical)
mechanism: inhaled dry-powder small molecule for COPD; target not disclosed in sources found
latest_data: Phase I SAD/MAD study of TQC3927 inhalation powder in COPD patients (n=48) completed Aug 2025 (NCT06711991); a multicenter randomized open-label Phase II dose-ranging study in COPD is listed (Synapse). No efficacy data disclosed publicly.
notes: Sponsor confirmed as Chia Tai Tianqing (CTTQ) on ClinicalTrials.gov. Sister program TQC3721 is CTTQ's inhaled PDE3/4 inhibitor; TQC3927 target not confirmed.

mechanism: adipose-targeted THR-beta selective agonist (UCP-1-mediated thermogenesis), long-acting subcutaneous, once-monthly; muscle-preserving weight loss
indications: obesity (monotherapy and in combination with semaglutide)
latest_data: Phase Ib (Australia, 2025): single SC 90 mg in obese subjects gave placebo-adjusted weight loss peaking at 1.7% on day 50; t1/2 ~21 days supports monthly dosing; well tolerated up to 90 mg with no SAEs. ECO 2026: ASC47 + semaglutide showed 111.8% greater weight loss than semaglutide alone (Phase I). US FDA cleared IND for ASC47 + semaglutide combination (Mar 2025).
first_in_class_note: Positioned by Ascletis as first-in-class muscle-preserving, adipose-targeted THR-beta agonist for obesity
notes: Ascletis (HKEX: 1672) runs its own trials in Australia and the US; no ex-China licensing found.

mechanism: fully human IgG1-like EGFR/c-MET bispecific antibody (signal blockade + ADCC)
indications: NSCLC (EGFR exon 20 insertion)|EGFR-mutant NSCLC 1L in combination with aumolertinib|colorectal cancer|head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
latest_data: ESMO TAT Asia 2026 (June): Phase I data in EGFR ex20ins advanced NSCLC showed promising activity with median PFS 9.6 months and median DoR 16.6 months.
first_in_class_note: Amivantamab-like EGFR/c-MET bispecific; positioned as chemo-free combination partner with Hansoh's own EGFR TKI aumolertinib
notes: Registered Phase Ib/III (NCT06417008) combining HS-20117 with aumolertinib in 1L EGFR-mutant non-squamous NSCLC; ct.gov lists it as PHASE2/PHASE3 so highest phase recorded as phase 3.

mechanism: KATP channel opener lowering episcleral venous pressure / distal outflow resistance (topical ophthalmic)
indications: primary open-angle glaucoma|ocular hypertension|normal tension glaucoma|nonproliferative diabetic retinopathy
latest_data: Positive topline results from two US Phase II trials in POAG/OHT: QLS-111 added to latanoprost gave up to 3.6 mmHg greater IOP reduction than latanoprost alone.
notes: Code-prefix seed (Qilu Pharmaceutical, 'QLS') was wrong: QLS = Qlaris Bio, a US (Massachusetts) company founded 2019. Not Chinese.

mechanism: humanized bispecific antibody co-blocking IL-4R alpha (type I/II receptors) and TSLP
latest_data: ATS 2026 (May): randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled single-dose Phase Ib study in mild-to-moderate asthma showed significant improvement in lung function (FEV1) and other markers with good tolerability; preclinically matched dupilumab/tezepelumab at 4-9x lower exposure.
first_in_class_note: Described by Innovent as first-in-class anti-IL-4Ra/TSLP bispecific antibody
notes: First-in-human study run in Australia (2024); Phase 2 ongoing per ct.gov listing (asthma, atopic dermatitis).

latest_data: Phase II randomized placebo/active-controlled dose-ranging study in Chinese patients with primary hypercholesterolemia or mixed dyslipidemia completed; Phase III program (incl. HeFH study NCT07465263, primary completion expected Feb 2028) now recruiting. No numeric efficacy data found.
notes: Developed by CSPC subsidiary Hebei Zhongnuo Pharmaceutical (Shijiazhuang); IND approved in China Nov 2023.

sponsor: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group (Sino Biopharmaceutical)
mechanism: oral allosteric TYK2/JAK1 JH2 inhibitor blocking IL-23 and type I IFN signaling
indications: plaque psoriasis|psoriatic arthritis|Crohn's disease|ulcerative colitis|systemic lupus erythematosus
latest_data: 2026: Phase II in moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis (n=209, placebo + 5 dose groups, QD oral) met primary endpoint with efficacy described as comparable to IL-17/IL-23 biologics and superior to deucravacitinib/apremilast; Phase III (24 mg QD, ~400 pts, NCT07724366) initiated.
first_in_class_note: Positioned as best-in-class oral TYK2 allosteric inhibitor vs deucravacitinib
notes: Sponsor entity on trials: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Nanjing Shunxin Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (CTTQ subsidiary).

mechanism: Fc-engineered anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody (enhanced killing of CD38+ cells)
indications: CD38+ hematologic malignancies|multiple myeloma|AL amyloidosis|plasma cell-driven autoimmune diseases|systemic lupus erythematosus
latest_data: Phase I dose-finding (0.01-960 mg) in R/R CD38+ hematologic malignancies (NCT06252298) ongoing; Phase I/II in plasma-cell-driven autoimmune disease and Phase III studies registered 2025-2026. No efficacy readout found.
notes: Daratumumab-class follow-on; Phase III trials per ct.gov (n=2) in MM/AL amyloidosis settings.
